title: Design for Citywide Open-End Bridge
short_description: RFQ for citywide bridge design consulting services for DDOT in Washington, DC.
project_scope: Citywide open-end bridge design consultant services for the District Department of Transportation. The notice indicates a bridge-focused on-call/open-end assignment across Washington, DC, rather than a single defined bridge project. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and traffic design engineering. No specific bridge types, spans, quantities, or individual project locations are stated.
services: Bridge design consultant services under an RFQ/RFP framework/open-end contract; disciplines requested: civil engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, hydrology/hydraulics, and traffic design engineering; base period 12 months with 48 months renewal option.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge-related engineering services are generally relevant to sbp.
- Structural engineering is explicitly requested.
- However, this is a citywide open-end/on-call contract without defined technical scope, spans, or standout structural challenges.
- The tender appears broad and framework-like rather than focused on a specific innovative bridge.
- Such undefined multi-project bridge contracts are less attractive than clearly specified individual bridge projects.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The source only gives a contract value range of 1000000 to 25000000, which appears to refer to consultant contract value rather than construction cost. No bridge quantities, sizes, or project list are provided, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee for sbp is stated. The source mentions a contract value range of 1000000 to 25000000 for the consultant contract, but this is too broad and likely represents the total on-call contract ceiling rather than a specific design fee allocable to sbp.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications are requested from architecture and engineering firms for bridge design consultant services. Required capability areas include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum number of references or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
